messages.body: Opening a thread for the Saida count. WH-22, canned cheese FOO-CHS-024. Both stock cards are in pieces. The floor sheet has boxes and loose pieces.
FA-2026, expiry 30 Nov: 12 boxes + 6 pieces on the floor. 24 per box so 294. Card says 288.
EA-2026, same expiry: 11 boxes + 6 pieces here, 270. Card says 342. There’s a later expiry on both cards too, those rows tie.
Let’s reconcile each project and expiry on its own line. FA’s plus six can’t offset any of the EA shortage, even though they share the rack.
تمام، كل مشروع لحاله ومنفصل كمان حسب تاريخ الصلاحية.
Is that 342 the balance after the last dispatch or before?
After DSP-2026-00418. I used the whole EA card through that dispatch, not the balance on the receipt.
Recount is Thursday at 9 in aisle 4. We’ll check the overflow racks too.
Generator’s on but the fan in aisle 4 has given up. bring water
@Rami Nassar can you lead the floor recount at WH-22?
إيه، أنا بتولّى إعادة العدّ وبمشي على الرفوف مع الفريق.
Can we move the recount to next Monday at 9? Aisle 4 is full of the WASH kits waiting on dispatch and the hand truck can’t get through.
D’accord pour lundi à neuf heures. Le passage sera libre.
Let’s use one signed recount sheet with separate blocks for FA and EA. Easier to carry around the racks.
fine by me, two blocks on the same sheet
Just got power back at home. My coffee’s been in the microwave since lunch 😅
Any chance of moving the recount up to Friday? I’ll be in Saida anyway.
Friday won’t work. WASH pallets are still by the rack.
DMG-2026-00037 is open for 24 EA pieces. Incident note says 'One carton reported crushed during the rack move. Carton missing from aisle 4 at count, condition still to verify.'
Did opening the DMG already take 24 off the card?
No. The report needs the written incident note, then an ops manager’s approval before it can post a write-off. This one is pending.
@Karim Fawaz tu peux récupérer la photo de l’étiquette de l’ancien rayonnage ?
Could we shift the recount to Tuesday, same time? My kid’s got a fever and the clinic squeezed us in Monday morning.
Oui, on décale le recomptage à mardi, neuf heures. Bon courage avec le petit.
بأي مجلّد انحفظت النسخة الموقّعة من مخطّط الرفوف القديم؟
Saida is an oven. Even my water bottle’s warm.
We’re counting now. Someone had written 12 in the pieces column on the rough sheet. That’s 12 boxes, I’ve fixed the rough sheet.
Scans of the signed count sheets by tomorrow end of day please. Final investigation pack is due July 10.
لقينا الكرتونة بالممرّ السادس ورا كراتين النظافة. بعدها مسكّرة وما فيها ضرر.
EA tag is still on it and the lot matches the 30 Nov row. Counted 24 inside with Dima. Tape was clean, corners fine.
Withdrawing DMG-2026-00037. Carton found intact in aisle 6. I added that to the incident note and closed the report as withdrawn.
Recount totals for 30 Nov: FA 294 vs card 288. EA now 294 vs card 342. The 28 Feb 2027 rows still tie, 144 FA and 96 EA.
Could we drop the joint sheet and sign one sheet for each project? The two project files each need a signed original.
موافقة، منترك الورقة المشتركة ومنوقّع ورقة لحال لكل مشروع.
I’ll put the investigation pack together, including the signed sheet scans and the card extracts.
Who signs the stock adjustment if the FA six stay unexplained? The keeper or ops?
Final call on adjustment signatures: the operations manager signs. The keeper signs the count sheets for their own warehouse. Leave the WH-22 adjustment sign-off with me.
ok, that answers it thanks
The project monitoring visit to WH-22 is booked for in two weeks, 11 in the morning.
Internal evidence review is July 8 at 9, on the channel call. We need that for the pack anyway.
@Tarek Zoghaib can you trace the EA transfer in the admin log and handle any reversal once I’ve approved it?
yes on it. I’ve got the two cards open now
Did WH-19 send one truck or two for TRF-2026-00142? I can see two postings against the same ref.
One truck from WH-19. One signed waybill, 48 pieces of EA 30 Nov, WH-19 EA to WH-22 EA.
Both signed count sheet scans are in the evidence folder. The scanner finally came back after the power cut.
Confirmed. TRF-2026-00142 was booked twice, both legs each time. The second posting came through after a retry. Only the first has a matching waybill.
Let’s append a linked reversal for the second posting only. Minus 48 at WH-22 EA, plus 48 back to WH-19 EA, same expiry. No physical move.
D’accord, on contre-passe seulement la deuxième écriture. Les deux écritures d’origine restent visibles dans le journal.
Maybe add a photo of the empty overflow bays to the final pack too?
Preview shows WH-22 EA going 342 to 294 and WH-19 EA 120 to 168, both on 30 Nov. No negative balance. Ready for the signature.
Paper archive check goes in the tracker for July 2. That’s the search for a missing FA receipt or dispatch slip.
Petite correction dans le tableau : la vérification des archives papier est le 9 juillet.
Nour created and signed TRF-2026-00157. I posted it against the second entry for 00142. EA 30 Nov now ties at WH-22.
WH-19 confirms 168 on that row. Both original entries and the reversal are visible on our card.
What was the generator runtime during the first count? The site log has an empty box there.
Home now. Kid’s back to stealing my toast so I think we’re good.
The FA variance memo is due end of the week, before we lock up Friday. There’s a spot for the archive result in the addendum.
Are the six loose pieces actually marked FA, or are we going off which side of the rack they were on?
FA on the open carton tag. All six cans have the 30 Nov stamp. We checked beside RCV-2026-00361 and the dispatch slips, nothing for six pieces.
Got the photo. I can read the project tag now. The first scan was all glare.
FA variance memo is filed. Six pieces confirmed in both counts, source of the variance still open.
Signed the FA adjustment for +6 pieces on 30 Nov. Approved on the signed recount and variance memo. No damage write-off.
FA card now has the +6 adjustment as its own movement. 294 on the 30 Nov row. Next pick still takes that expiry first.
The closeout readout is booked for the 14th at 10.
sorry, I meant the 15th not the 14th. Same time.
Can I see the WH-22 stock card myself? I only have WH-19 in the dropdown.
Your keeper access is WH-19 only. The WH-22 card extract is already in the shared evidence folder if you need the lines for the call.
The admin picker’s loading all 40 sites and about 3,000 item codes again. No wonder the card export took forever.
La visite de suivi de 11 h est annulée, l’équipe ne viendra pas à Saïda.
Our internal evidence review is still on at 9. Same call link.
Joining from the loading bay. AC’s dead in the office and it’s already brutal.
Review done. The two project sheets each tie to their own card. The withdrawn DMG is still visible with zero pieces posted.
Paper archive check done. Nothing in the signed slips explains the FA six. The drawer had two copies of 00361, both stamped as the same receipt.
Added the archive result to the memo. The RCV copies match the scan already in the pack.
Final pack filed for 10/07. Both count sheets, memo and addendum, withdrawn report and linked transfer reversal are in there.
tamam. Both cards still tie after the morning pick. Finally going for that coffee.
